evals.name: deslop-newsletter-intro
evals.prompt:
I wrote this intro for my newsletter with ChatGPT and it sounds like a robot. Can you rewrite it so it sounds like an actual person wrote it? Here it is:

"In today's fast-paced digital landscape, staying productive is more crucial than ever. Whether you're a seasoned entrepreneur or just starting out, mastering your workflow can be a game-changer. In this issue, we'll delve into three powerful strategies that will not only boost your efficiency but also transform the way you work."
evals.expected_output: A rewritten intro that reads as human: no throat-clearing opener, none of the tell-words (crucial, delve, game-changer), no 'not only... but also', varied sentence length, a real voice. Should stay a newsletter intro (short, inviting), not become an essay.

evals.name: write-notion-to-plaintext-post
evals.prompt: Write a short blog post (~400 words) about why I switched from Notion to plain text files for my notes. I'm a freelance web developer. Make it sound like me, a real person, not like SEO marketing copy.
evals.expected_output: A ~400-word first-person blog post with a clear stance, concrete specifics (real reasons/tools), varied rhythm, contractions, no AI tells, no throat-clearing intro or recap conclusion.

evals.name: coffee-roastery-about-section
evals.prompt: Write the 'About' section for my small coffee roastery website. We're called Cedar & Ash, based in Portland, we roast light, and we mostly sell to home espresso folks. Keep it around 150 words and don't make it sound like every other startup 'About' page.
evals.expected_output: ~150-word About section with concrete detail specific to Cedar & Ash, a distinct voice, no relentless-positivity marketing slop, no tell-words (artisanal/passion/vibrant/journey/crafted), some rhythm variation.
